name: Popup Redirect for Percup
author: percup

sections.description:
Popup Redirect for Percup is a plugin designed to be a practical tool for all WordPress users who need to implement a popup for redirect to percup site.

Privacy notices

With the default configuration, this plugin, in itself, does not:

  • track users by stealth;
  • write any user personal data to the database;
  • use cookies.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to determine the brand status based on the user’s location, which is required to display the Percup popup.

Each time the widget is loaded, it sends the user’s location and the brand URL to the API. If the location is not available and/or the user has not provided consent, the plugin displays a configurable default location.

This service is provided by PERCUP.

Terms & Conditions: https://percup.com/pages/t-c
Privacy Policy: https://percup.com/pages/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire percup folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).

You will find Percup menu in your WordPress admin screen.
